items.title: Rainy Days
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
It's a rainy day in Minecraft! Grab your raincoat and hoodies to stay dry! Look cute while doing it. 

+ 12 skins to choose from!

items.title: Fall Sweaters
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Prepare for the leaves to fall and the air to get chilly, break out your sweaters and get ready for spooky season!

+ 14 skins to choose from!

items.title: Oktoberfest
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Are you ready for everyone's favorite fall festival? Get ready to check out amusement rides and play games in these festive Oktoberfest skins!

+ 12 skins to choose from!

items.title: Rainbow Scarecrows
items.creator: Piston Solutions
items.description:
Express your true self with this range of emotive and colorful scarecrow skins, just in time for the spooky season!

- 1 Free Skin!
- 8 Colorful Scarecrow Skins
- By Piston Solutions & Origin Realms

items.title: Halloween Masks
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for Halloween? Perfect, put on these epic skins with cool masks and start trick-or-treating in your next roleplay adventure!

- 10 masked Halloween teen skins!
- 1 free skin!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Neon Legends
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
Be a true legend with this collection of 30 neon-warrior-themed skins! Varying in color and style, choose the one that is right for you and battle your way through any challenge!
-2 Free

items.title: Urban Style
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Come and enjoy with these guys in urban style!

- 11 Skins
- 1 Free
- By UnderBlocks

items.title: Explorer Mobs
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to explore new maps in Minecraft with these awesome mob skins? Choose your favorite skin now and take your first step on an amazing adventure!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Dark Aesthetic
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Enjoy dressing up in dark clothes? Then this is the skin pack for you!

+ 12 teen skins
+ A variety of moody clothes

items.title: NEON TEENS
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Light up the night as you battle or create your world with one of these epic neon skins! Choose from a variety of colors and make everyone jealous of your style. Shine bright Minecraft gamers.

21 HD skins including:


- 20 multiple color neon outfits
- 1 exclusive free skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Cozy Dozy
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Sometimes a little cozy feeling is just right for the mood. Find that cozy vibe in these new fresh styles! Get that cozy drip!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, luxury attire!

items.title: Blingy Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Teens put on your bling! Your fashion will be on point with these skins and get you the drip to look as cool as can be!

items.title: Free Choice Anime
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Super anime teens come into action! Dyed hair, expensive clothes, fashionable accessories, and trendy hoodies will make you stand out from the crowd. Discover a new pack full of amazing characters and feel like your favorite anime hero. Show others that you know fashion by choosing from these stylish friends!

-1 free skin
-anime vibe
-luxury clothes

items.title: Teen Street Fashion
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Dress up in modern clothes with the Teen Street Fashion skin pack. Wear pastels in the streets of Harujuku, or be dark and punk somewhere in the west - the choice is yours!

• Includes 12 different skins, representing different modern fashion trends!
• From pastels to high fashion, to punk and dark themes.
• Includes 2 free skins for any fashionista!

items.title: Skyland Crystal Mines
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Welcome to Skyland, a super computer simulation. The adventure is great but the dangers are greater. Watch your back, these floating islands are treacherous. Are you up for the rising challenge?

-Three difficulties
-Collect the resources to survive.
-Take on newer and bigger challenges.

items.title: Cliffside Barrel Base
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
A cozy cliffside house! What else would complete your adventurous personality if not a cozy home for you to take a rest at?!
Immerse yourself with the amazing view this home offers!

-Fully furnished house!
-Explore this unique base!
-And much more!

items.title: Modern Cliffside Base
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Treat yourself to the majestic ocean view from your modern home! Breathe in the fresh air to ready yourself with energy right before your epic adventure!

-Fantastic ocean view!
-Modern peaceful home!
-Huge explorable to explore!
-And much more!

items.title: Bezma
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
After walking for days you finally find Bezma, the lost city of the endless desert. For a century the city has been left untouched and its inhabitants have been forgotten. Can you restore the city to its former glory?

- Roleplay as king or queen of this great empire.
- Find all the hidden loot around the city.
- Explore the pyramids and what they hide.

items.title: Haunted Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Want to test your fears? Looking for a mansion to buy? Then you’re in the perfect place; explore this spooky haunted mansion alone or with others!

- Haunted Mansion
- 30+ Survival base rooms

items.title: Rich Teens HD
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description: Do you want to impress everyone with your look? This skin pack is for you! Be a rich teenager with these 10 original HD skins!

items.title: Bears
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Team Workbench presents: Bears! Meet one of nature's greatest beasts. They are not your normal pets as they live in the wild. Spawning like any other mob in the world. Tame them, play with them and they might even get sleepy. This map is made with animal lovers in mind!

+ Cute baby bears
+ 4 colors
+ Licensed by Team Workbench and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Witch House
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Do you have the courage to visit a witch house? Explore the horror house, the underground base and try to survive on all levels. Find good equipment for fights against monsters and the witch boss. Will magic defeat courage? 

+ 4 HD skins
+ Custom mobs
+ Great for multiplayer with friends
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Supercars
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Jump in one of the many Supercars and start racing! Drift around or enjoy your luxurious modern mansion! Race your friends or enjoy this world of cars on your own! Are you going with a classic-looking car or a modern race monster?

+ 200+ vehicle variants! 
+ Moden mansion base!

items.title: World of Mining
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Mine new ores with new machines! Upgrade your vehicles and mine even MORE, even FASTER! Craft explosives out of uranium or take a rocket to space to start mining SPACE DIAMONDS! What are you waiting for? Ditch that pick-axe and get yourself some modern digging machines! 

+ 5 new ores
+ 3D printer!
+ 5 upgradable mining machines!
+ Space!
+ Multiplayer & Single player!
